title: When Children Give Their Hearts to God
description: When Children Give Their Hearts to God in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 741 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Early Piety”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: When child-ren give their hearts to God, 'Tis pleas-ing in his eyes; A flower, when of-fered in the bud, Is no vain sac-ri-fice.

lines: When children give their hearts to God,
A flower, when offered in the bud,
It saves us from a thousand snares
Grace will preserve our following years,
To thee, Almighty God, to thee
'Twill please us to look back and see,
That our whole lives were thine.

licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
